content.title: 2026 NFL Draft: Every team's full set of picks
content.text: Published: Mar 12, 2026 at 01:31 PM Updated: Mar 23, 2026 at 05:14 PM Here is a look at the picks each team holds in the 2026 NFL Draft, from No. 1 through No. 257. But first, a few details about this year's event: When is the 2026 NFL Draft? Round 1: Thursday, April 23, beginning at 8 p.m. ET. Rounds 2 and 3: Friday, April 24, beginning at 7 p.m. ET. Rounds 4 through 7: Saturday, April 25, beginning at noon ET. Where will the 2026 NFL Draft be held? The 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh, in the lots surrounding Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park. * -- Denotes a pick involved in a trade that is not yet official.
